title: Personas with Attitudes: Controlling LLMs for Diverse Data Annotation

bias_targets.methodology: Modifying neutral persona descriptions in LLM prompts to include explicit racial markers (e.g., 'Black') and comparing the resulting shifts in toxicity annotations on African-American English (AAE) and anti-Black posts against neutral and conservative personas.

Injecting explicit ideological markers (e.g., 'conservative') into neutral persona descriptions and measuring how the LLMs' toxicity ratings for AAE and anti-Black posts differ compared to ratings from neutral and Black personas.
